description: Exact-SKU CPU manufacturer, broad architecture family and single DDR memory platform references. Model/platform references only; they do not verify hardware installed in a listing. memory_platform is null when the platform supports more than one DDR generation or no primary memory source was verified.
architecture_labels: Vendor codenames reduced to broad families: Sandy/Ivy Bridge-EP/EN, Nehalem-EP, Westmere-EP, Haswell-E, Skylake-W, Milan-X and Sapphire Rapids HBM map to their base family; distinct generations (e.g. Rome vs Milan, Genoa vs Bergamo vs Siena vs Turin) stay separate.
